name: Grok Build
summary: xAI 的终端编程 agent：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: xAI's terminal coding agent: view sessions, status and full conversations; reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when it runs in tmux

Windows 上没有 tmux，只能查看
回复和确认需要 Grok Build 在 tmux 中运行

limitsNote: Grok Build 不在本机记录 SuperGrok 订阅的额度，也没有提供查询接口，「今日用量」中不显示；用 xAI API Key 按量付费时请在 xAI 控制台查看余额。token 按 Grok Build 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: Grok Build doesn't record your SuperGrok plan quota on your computer and offers no way to query it, so it isn't shown under Today's usage; with pay-as-you-go xAI API keys, check your balance in the xAI console. Tokens are counted from Grok Build's own records
speaker: Grok
notes: 新接入 Grok Build：查看会话和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可从手机回复、审批命令、回答提问、中断和关闭会话；用量统计计入 Grok Build 的 token。
notesEn: New: Grok Build support. View sessions and full conversations; when it runs in tmux, reply, approve commands, answer questions, interrupt and close sessions from your phone. Usage stats include Grok Build's tokens.
